question: Separate best-channel availability from endpoint ranking loss for every fixed arm and both endpoint rankers.
definition: For each parent average over three training seeds: availability=hit_infinity; ranking_loss=availability-H. Identity deltaH=deltaAvailability-deltaRankingLoss.
scope: All13 arms, both rankers, all24 original paired comparisons. No selected subgroups, new chemistry, generation, or parameter optimization.
interval: Paired parent values, split_group cluster_summary two-sided95%.
interpretation: Posthoc algebraic mechanism diagnostic. gates: Exact input hash; parent catalogue hash pinned in input provenance;62 parents/3seed-averaged values; H<=availability; availability equal across rankers; all identities within1e-12.
